d: From childhood, Wing Commander Ashok Limey dreamed of flying fighter aircraft, a dream he eventually made real in the Indian Air Force. After years of flying and a life built around the skies, an accident in the cockpit left him unable to use his legs. Doctors said he might never walk again. But with his wife Priya, daughters and his own determination beside him, Ashok began the long journey back. Through exercise, technology and sheer perseverance, he returned to the Air Force, proving that even when life changes course, the spirit can still rise.
